name: Building Connect
summary: Sydney/Western Sydney wholesale telecoms carrier (Building Connect Pty Ltd, AS134093) with a fixed-wireless network covering 31 buildings and business parks and 200+ business customers; acquired by Spirit Telecom (May 2019, $300k).

events.details: Sydney telco wholesaler; AS134093 allocated 26 Jul 2017.
Acquired by Spirit Telecom (May 2019, $300k); team and Western Sydney fixed-wireless network retained. buildingconnect.com.au served 301 redirects post-acquisition (last 200 capture Nov 2019).

The earliest Wayback captures of buildingconnect.com.au (from 27 Apr 2014) show an unrelated Perth IT firm, Blue Wire Technologies, not the Sydney telco wholesaler — so those captures do not evidence Building Connect's founding; its own content appears from ~2016.

refs.label: CRN: Spirit Telecom acquires telco wholesaler Building Connect (2019)
